candidates.description: This feature vector represents the lexical pattern or suffix "-or" found at the end of various English nouns and adjectives.
This feature detects proper nouns, historical figures, and prominent names, often associated with cultural, scientific, or political icons.
These tokens represent historical and traditional European and American given names.
This vector represents European male given names.
This vector represents Spanish suffix morphemes and adjective endings containing the character sequence "ient".
This feature vector activates on common Portuguese grammatical words, pronouns, and prepositions.
This vector represents prefixes and roots associated with the mind, psychology, and neurology.
This feature vector activates strongly on medical, pharmaceutical, and biological terms related to treatments, toxic substances, and physiological trauma.
This vector represents adverbial and nominal suffixes, particularly those related to the "-ly" and "-ment" morphological patterns in Romance languages.
This vector activates strongly on tokens containing the lowercase letter sequence "el" or starting with the letters "El".
